examples: This has no test coverage? Can we add coverage for it?
Is this safe? It is pulling third party js into our checkout page... has security signed off on this?
Is there a way to validate the integrity, or simply use our own CDN?
Can we add `.replace(/'/g, "'")` to harden the guard
Was this supposed to be checked in?
I am confused why some things use translations, some things are hard coded strings, and if these are all by design?
toneNotes: Prefer a question over an assertion—ask what matters rather than declaring a problem.
No hedging, no preamble (no 'I know this is out of scope but'), no hypotheticals—just the observation or the ask.
Name the fix directly when it's obvious; don't justify it or build a case for why it matters.
No reviewer attribution ('three of us think') and no re-explaining what the author already knows.
Terse and collegial—usually one or two sentences, enough for the author to know what you mean.
